Pride History

In 476 BC,

the very first Beer Olympics originated in ancient Greece where the first cups were flipped and chugged to start into a legacy of fabulous competition.

In 2012,

a new chapter began with a surge of enthusiastic, driven talent eager for glory. Their energy and passion sparked a fresh hope and signaled a thrilling future for the games.

By 2018,

new and inventive games were introduced to the competition. With no limits on creativity, versatility and an all-around skill set became the keys to success.

In 2021,

the first team-based games were introduced, placing a strong emphasis on teamwork and celebrating unity at the heart of the competition.

By 2023,

the Beer Olympics became faster, sexier, and more creative than ever, pushing the boundaries of athleticism and artistry in a spectacular celebration of diversity.

In 2024,

we celebrated the Beer Olympics great tradition. Let the games begin, and may new legends be made in this 2,500-year celebration of beer and games!
